components.name: Phoenix Brand Mark Lockup
components.description: Sidebar header brand lockup pairing the high-fidelity Rising Plume obsidian squircle medallion (`PhoenixMark` plate variant) with the wide-tracked geometric uppercase PHOENIX vector wordmark.
components.css: .ds-brand-lockup { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--foreground, #f0ede6); text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-lockup:hover { background: var(--accent, #292623); } .ds-brand-lockup:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #e85d26); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Signal Orange primary action for sending prompts or committing key actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--primary, #e85d26); color: var(--primary-foreground, #141312); font-family: "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d1501d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #e85d26); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Control Button
components.description: Machined neutral control for secondary toolbar and panel actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--secondary, #242220); color: var(--secondary-foreground, #f0ede6); font-family: "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #302d2a); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #2d2a27; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #e85d26); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hardware Status Badge
components.description: Tabular monospace readout displaying local inference host and decode rate.
components.css: .ds-badge-hardware { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--card, #242220); color: var(--success, #3fa66b); border: 1px solid var(--border, #302d2a); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 8px; font-family: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Sidebar Thread Row
components.description: Active and idle thread rows on the Machined Stone sidebar.
components.html: Rebrand shell & iconsnowLocal vision probe fallback14m
components.css: .ds-thread-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 248px; padding: 8px; background: var(--sidebar, #1c1b19); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-thread-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 4px; border-left: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--sidebar-foreground, #f0ede6); font-family: "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-thread-row:hover { background: var(--sidebar-row-hover, #242220); } .ds-thread-row.ds-thread-active { background: var(--sidebar-row-active, #292623); border-left-color: var(--primary, #e85d26); font-weight: 600; } .ds-thread-time { font-family: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9c968e); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-thread-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #e85d26); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Composer Field
components.description: Tactile prompt composer anchored over Anodized Charcoal with Signal Orange focus.
components.css: .ds-composer { background: var(--card, #1c1b19); border: 1px solid var(--input, #3a3632); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--ring, #e85d26); } .ds-composer-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--foreground, #f0ede6); caret-color: var(--primary, #e85d26); font-family: "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; outline: none; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder, #9c968e); }

narrative.overview:
Phoenix pairs the clarity of a precision engineering workbench with high-fidelity, tactile visual craft. Rather than austere, bare-text-only minimalism, Phoenix embraces rich obsidian depth, subtle top-lit metallic rim highlights, luminous stepped ember gradients on brand moments, and deliberate spatial hierarchy that makes local GPUs, SSH workstations, inference queues, and coding agents feel like flagship craft software.

Warm obsidian grounds (#141312 canvas, #1c1b19 stone panels, #0b0a0a deep medallion wells) anchor the workspace so the luminous Rising Plume mark, active indicators, diffs, and floating surfaces carry crisp tactile dimensionality without ever sacrificing scanability or frame-rate discipline.
keyCharacteristics: Rich warm obsidian grounds (#141312 standard dark, #000000 OLED, #f3f1ec daylight paper) with tactile tonal layering, hairline top-edge specular highlights, and refined ambient depth.
Luminous stepped fire spectrum on brand moments — sunlit ivory-gold (#fffdf0 / #fbbf24), Signal Orange (#e85d26 / #c84614), and forged crimson (#a51b10) grounded by volcanic ash (#58534e).
Polished hardware radii (6px controls, 10px panels, 22% squircle medallions) paired with crisp 1px borders and subtle inset highlights.
Self-hosted Public Sans for UI legibility and JetBrains Mono for code, diffs, and hardware telemetry.
High-fidelity Rising Plume emblem (five sculpted flame feathers rising from a golden spark and faceted ash diamond) paired with the wide-tracked uppercase PHOENIX vector wordmark.

rules.name: The Focal Warmth Rule
rules.body: Reserve the luminous fire gradient and radial ember glow for the Rising Plume emblem, splash/onboarding lockups, and focal brand surfaces; keep everyday workspace chrome grounded in warm obsidian so primary actions (#e85d26 / #c84614) stand out cleanly.

rules.name: The Hardware Honesty Rule
rules.body: Local-ready green (#3fa66b) and fault red (#e5484d) appear only on real runtime state (inference servers, queue status, diffs), never as decorative ornament.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Every numerical readout (TTFT, tok/s, context size, token counts, diff counts) uses JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals so columns never jitter while streaming.

rules.name: The Zero-Cost Motion Rule
rules.body: Never ship continuously repainting CSS animations; status indicators and transitions settle cleanly (180ms exponential ease-out) so 120Hz displays stay idle at rest.

dos: Do bring high-fidelity material polish — subtle top-lit hairlines, calibrated elevation, and crisp visual hierarchy — to brand touchpoints, medallions, onboarding, and flagship surfaces.
Do use the Rising Plume PhoenixMark (plate / brand / mono) and PhoenixWordmark consistently across desktop, web, mobile, DMG, and docs.
Do pair Public Sans Variable for UI prose with JetBrains Mono Variable for code, diffs, and numeric hardware telemetry.
Do preserve full compatibility with THEME_COLOR_ROLES across Light, Standard Dark, OLED, and user-imported themes.
donts: Don't reintroduce T3 Code or M3 Code names, wordmarks, icons, or royal-blue (#1b4ed8 / #346bf1) default accents.
Don't add continuously repainting CSS animations that peg the GPU on high-refresh displays.
Don't sacrifice legibility or scannability for ornamental clutter — polish should sharpen hierarchy, never obscure code or diffs.
Don't restyle apps/web/src/components/ui primitives inline from parent components; define shared variants on the primitives themselves.
